Name: Stardead Valley
Author: kinduff
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardead Valley[/b][/size]

Round-based zombies, but it's Pelican Town and the zombies are your neighbors.

There's a hand sticking out of the dirt in the town graveyard. Grab it and you wake up in the same town at night, alone, with a Pea Shooter, a Bone Sword and 500 points. A few seconds later the villagers start climbing out of the ground.

If you've played a zombies mode in a shooter you already know how this goes. Shoot zombies, get points, spend points. Guns hang on signs around town. There's a crate that gives you a random gun. There are drinks that make you tougher or faster, but only once you get the power on. Most of the town is blocked off by barrels and you pay to open it up bit by bit. Rounds get harder until you go down.

None of it touches your save. When the shift ends you're back where you were, same time of day, same stuff in your pockets. You can't lose anything, so go nuts.

[size=4][b]What's in it[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Rounds that keep getting bigger and faster. Every fifth one is void chickens.[/*]
[*]Six guns: the Pea Shooter you start with, the Corn Popper (a shotgun, basically), the Sprinkler (full auto), the Carrot Carbine (goes through three zombies), and two you can only get from Qi's Crate. I won't spoil those.[/*]
[*]A forge at the smithy that upgrades whatever you're holding. It's expensive.[/*]
[*]Six drinks, sold around town once the power is on: double health, faster shooting, faster running, a third gun slot, faster reloads, and one that picks you back up when you go down.[/*]
[*]Thirteen districts to open. You start locked in the graveyard and the breaker for the power is at JojaMart, on the far side of the river.[/*]
[*]Boards. Zombies always come out of the same holes and doors, and each one starts boarded up. They have to rip the boards off first. Stand next to a hole and hold the action button to nail them back.[/*]
[*]The mayor. He shows up every third round, he's huge, and he takes a lot of killing. He always drops something good.[/*]
[*]Drops: a bomb that clears the map, double points, one-hit kills, max ammo, a nearly free crate roll, and a Bee House that shoots bees for 30 seconds.[/*]
[*]Lightning rods at a few chokepoints. Pay, and a storm kills whatever walks through for 20 seconds.[/*]
[*]Cherry bombs, two every round. They don't hurt you.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Difficulty[/b][/size]
The hand asks every time, and it keeps a separate best round for each.
[list]
[*][b]A quiet night (easy)[/b]: you can take five hits, zombies are weaker.[/*]
[*][b]A long night (normal)[/b]: four hits.[/*]
[*][b]The longest night (hard)[/b]: three hits, tougher zombies, and boards come off faster.[/*]
[/list]On normal or hard you get a Skeleton Mask for reaching round 10 and a Solid Gold Lewis for round 20. Once per save, and not on easy.

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Shoot: left click (X on controller). Mouse aims at the cursor, controller aims at the closest zombie in front of you.[/*]
[*]Buy things, open barricades: right click (A).[/*]
[*]Board a hole: hold right click (A) next to it.[/*]
[*]Reload: R (right stick click).[/*]
[*]Cherry bomb: G (left stick click).[/*]
[*]Swap weapons: number keys or triggers, same as tools.[/*]
[/list]I've played it on mouse and keyboard. Controller support is in there but hasn't had much testing, so tell me if something feels off.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Start the game and go to the graveyard in town. It's south of the saloon, by the river. The hand is in front of the middle gravestone.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Things to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single-player only for now. The hand won't do anything in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Needs Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or newer. I built it on 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2.[/*]
[*]Everything is placed for the vanilla town map. If you use a mod that changes the town layout, signs and barricades will probably end up in walls.[/*]
[*]The zombies are the vanilla villager sprites with glowing eyes. If you use a mod that redraws villagers, the eyes might sit in the wrong place.[/*]
[*]No config, no dependencies.[/*]
[*]The guns, the hand, the breaker box and the holes are my own sprites. Everything else is the game's art.[/*]
[/list]
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment or open a bug report here.
